reason: The previous robustness fixes did not improve ordinary photo accuracy. Follow-up work tests the core accuracy concerns from review.
prior_main1000_status: All 1000 previous outcomes have been observed and are exploratory development data.

development_screen.selection: SHA256(followup-dev-v1|sample_id), lowest 100 IDs from prior main1000
development_screen.baseline_repetition: Fresh baseline on the same 100 images measures changes against concurrent model requests; old responses remain archived.
development_screen.selection_rule: Choose the arm with lowest paired calorie MAE among arms with no worse all-selected within-15-percent count and no lower valid prediction count than fresh baseline; improvement must exceed 5 percent to advance. If none qualifies, retain all negative results and do not promote an arm solely by rank.
development_screen.full_development: An advancing frozen arm is evaluated on all 1000 prior samples before confirmation. Its first 100 frozen responses may be reused with matching input/config hashes. This is exploration, not a holdout success claim.

grounding_hypothesis: Compare the same model candidates and mass through real public MFDS ingredient references using existing exact matching, validated density gates, and conservative cooking-state-aware matching. No truth ingredient names, truth mass or Nutrition5k ingredient table may enter retrieval.

learned_mass_hypothesis.reason: The review also criticized prompt rules alone and lack of learned correction. Fit a small mass estimator from model output features and existing development truth masses.
learned_mass_hypothesis.training: Previous main1000 only; five inferred-group-disjoint folds; training-fold standardization only; ridge log mass regression with alpha 10,100,1000 selected by lowest development out-of-fold mass MAE.
learned_mass_hypothesis.inputs: Model-predicted mass, kcal density, food names, counts and confidence. No truth ingredients, truth mass, ID, camera or date as features.
learned_mass_hypothesis.application: A plate-level learned factor clipped to [0.5,2] scales candidate estimated_serving_g only. Preserve observed count, count unit, food identity, confidence and per100g nutrition. Replay actual pinned BE nutrition arithmetic. Protect package and printed/grounded label estimates.
learned_mass_hypothesis.evaluation: Alpha-selected cross-validation is exploratory. Only a single frozen final policy may be tested on new155. This does not remove the external VLM dependency.

development_amendment_after_large_portio.reason: Log-mass ridge improved overall exploratory errors but worsened the truth mass >=400g subgroup. Test loss-scale sensitivity before opening new confirmation labels.
development_amendment_after_large_portio.additional_family: Ridge with linear mass target, same features, group folds and alpha grid 10/100/1000. Nonpositive or nonfinite predicted mass falls back to original; positive factors remain clipped to [0.5,2].
development_amendment_after_large_portio.within_family_selection: Lowest out-of-fold mass MAE, as before
development_amendment_after_large_portio.deployment_candidate_filter: Require lower overall development mass and calorie MAE, nondecreasing all-selected within-15 count and valid coverage. Exclude a family if >=400g truth subgroup has at least30 cases and its calorie MAE worsens by more than10 percent. These are development selection checks, not confirmation claims.
development_amendment_after_large_portio.prompt_interaction: A fresh neutral_full run on all old1000 may be fitted and cross-validated separately. Its predictions must not be calibrated by a model trained on another prompt without explicitly treating it as a separate hypothesis.
development_amendment_after_large_portio.fresh_full_rerun: Repeat the 100 screen cases within fresh1000 rather than add response-reuse machinery; all extra calls remain in the cumulative budget.
development_amendment_after_large_portio.final_loss_variant_before_confirmation: After log and linear target families both worsened the large-portion development subgroup by more than10 percent, test one final weighted_log_mass family: training weight clip(truth_mass / median(training_fold_truth_mass),0.5,4), same features, group folds and alpha grid. Weights use training labels only. All acceptance and large-portion guards stay unchanged; keep negative results. No further loss-family tuning loop is planned.

confirmation.selection: All 155 remaining eligible inferred groups, disjoint from all prior pilot/main groups
confirmation.source_policy: First existing camera A, B, C, D; frame 0. Keep unavailable sources in denominator.
confirmation.labels: Kept in a separate gold file; opened for scoring only after candidate policy, prompts, code and source manifest are frozen.
confirmation.threshold_origin: Predeclared follow-up acceptance rule, not a numeric threshold prescribed by reviewers.
limitations: New groups have side-camera images only
Inferred grouping does not prove physical independence
Not representative Korean or packaged-food user traffic
confirmation.calorie_mae_metric_scope: Require at least 10% reduction both on exactly the same valid image pairs and on each arm overall valid predictions. Clarified during scorer audit before confirmation labels opened; paired CI, all-selected within15 and coverage gates also remain required.
confirmation.execution: Baseline and frozen Flash3.5 candidate run concurrently under one OS lock and one inherited Ledger object; 2 requests per arm, maximum4 combined. Six offline safety tests passed. No automatic resume/retry; prior ledger hash is checked before any collector starts.

production_gate: Only a confirmed improvement with compatible single-image API behavior and regression tests may be merged/deployed. Multi-image, user-text, packaged-label and existing FE contracts must remain covered. Unconfirmed hypotheses remain in the personal experiment repo.
reporting: Report all tested hypotheses, successes, failures, sample coverage, latency, cumulative budget, known limits, review mapping, and exact unresolved phrase required by the user.
sites_and_fe: Meta is on hold; no Meta or analytics dashboard mutations; FE unchanged.

external_model_comparison_amendment.reason: Review asks for periodic external-model comparison. Initial four arms varied prompt/thinking but used a single model. Add one bounded current low-cost model comparison before final selection.
external_model_comparison_amendment.arm: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, minimal thinking; exact original baseline prompt/schema, temperature0, seed20260722, maxoutput4096
external_model_comparison_amendment.dataset: Same frozen development100; fresh baseline_v1 reference. Exploratory only.
external_model_comparison_amendment.screen: Same >5% paired calorie MAE improvement, no lower valid count or all-selected within15 count. If it passes, evaluate frozen arm on old1000 before any confirmation; no new prompt tuning for this model.
external_model_comparison_amendment.deployment: Still requires one frozen final policy comparison on new155 and original confirmation gates. Never choose a per-case oracle model using truth.
external_model_comparison_amendment.cost: Same standard input0.30/output2.50 USD per million including thoughts; shared inherited US$30 ledger; no search/grounding/cache/tools/retries.
external_model_comparison_amendment.availability: Model listing describes stable model. API count-token failures or unsupported settings stop without automatic generation retries; record failures instead of substituting models.
